written: before any fit, score or metric of this stage
requested_by: Omri, 2026-09-24: understand exactly what happens in the new tail-mark L-SML method (why K=2); the 20% tail may be arbitrary and not suited to every feature; consider a FUSE-like binarization step with threshold tuning to maximize performance; running experiments on PRMBench now to calibrate this is fine, aiming at better clustering and a better PRMScore.

pre_protocol_probes_disclosed.what: read-only, label-free structure probes on outer fold 0 (fit folds 2,3,4) before this protocol: per-family position of 20% marks, mark and continuous correlation matrices, K of calfix_common.lsml_fit on marks at fractions .05/.10/.20/.30/.50 (K=2 at every fraction), and detect_dependent_groups on the SAME marks after column standardization (K=4 unit, 3 eigen, 4 complete) and on continuous F15 (K=5/3/5).
pre_protocol_probes_disclosed.consequence: the hypothesis that step-level K=2 is an input-scale artefact (unstandardized centred marks, variance ~0.16, fed to lsml_continuous whose documented input is z-scored and whose default 'unit' K criterion is not scale invariant) was formed from these probes; Stage 0 tests it on all folds and banks.

external_exposure: Codex/SOL is running the external evaluation of TRANSFER_LOCK_V1 (Hard2Verify + Socratic-PRMBench); family-tail Hard2Verify metric files existed on disk by 2026-09-24 ~20:43. This stage does not open them and reads no external data. Any recipe frozen after this stage is post-exposure in time and must say so. No external benchmark result is used to choose anything here.
frozen_check: sha256 of every file above recorded at run start and asserted equal at run end (FROZEN_HASHES.json)
population_and_roles: identical to family_tail_calfix_v1: 13,769 answers (PB+PRMB), source-group folds; outer fold k evaluates fold k, calibrates on (k+1)%5, fits on the other three; one fitted model per (method, fold) scores both roles (calfix_common.ScoreBundle, write-once).
representation: F15 exactly as family_tail_calfix_v1: 48 answer-standardized channels, retrospective orientation and kept list from run_20260924_1542/DESIGN.json (label-using development design, unchanged), 15 families of named_group_fusion_v1 S3_M15, equal mean of oriented members, answer-standardized. Anchor family level_entropy.
application: every learned weight vector is applied to the continuous F15 features, then within-answer z-score (unchanged from V1).

marks.rank: calfix_common.tail_marks(F15, q, tie_aware=True, centred=True): top ceil(q n) steps per answer and family, boundary ties share mass, centred within answer (V1 marks at q=.20)
marks.value: tail_calib_common.value_marks: 1[F15_j > tau_j] with tau_j the (1-q) quantile of family j over the outer fold's FIT rows (label-free), centred within answer; the FUSE-style value cut

fit_recipes.raw: calfix_common.lsml_fit on the centred marks as they are (the V1 recipe)
fit_recipes.standardized: tail_calib_common.lsml_fit_scaled(standardize=True): pooled column z-score of the fit-row marks (the documented lsml_continuous input contract), then the same lsml_continuous(small_m_guard=True) fit, Spearman orientation on continuous F15, sum|w|=1
fit_recipes.loading_scale: 'unit' (default, every committed number) unless the arm says 'complete' (exact Lemma-1 completion); it changes only the choice of K/partition

arms.T20raw: rank q=.20, raw recipe, unit == V1 F15_tailtie_lsml (must replay run_20260924_1542 scores bit-exactly)
arms.T20s: rank q=.20, standardized, unit (minimal defect fix; everything else as V1)
arms.T20s_votes: T20s weights mapped to the uncentred marks (w_j / fit sd_j), answer-z
arms.T20s_partition_equal: equal weights (1/(K n_k)) on T20s's discovered groups, applied to continuous F15
arms.curve Q{05,10,15,30,40,50}r: rank q, standardized, unit (Q20r is T20s)
arms.Qnest: per outer fold, the one of the 14 curve fits (Q..r incl. T20s, Q..v) with the highest FIT-fold PRMScore; ties -> first in the order Q05r..Q50r, Q05v..Q50v
arms.PFfree: per-family rank fractions from the grid, chosen label-free by coordinate descent (start .20 for all, 2 sweeps, move only on strict improvement, stop when a sweep moves nothing) MINIMIZING the relative latent-group misfit: Eq.14 residual of the best partition (complete scale, K in 2..8, Eq.15 spectral search) divided by the sum of squared off-diagonal correlations of the standardized fit-row marks; then fitted as T20s
arms.PFlab: per-family rank fractions, same coordinate descent MAXIMIZING the FIT-fold PRMScore (label-using, nested); then fitted as T20s. A fit failure during the search counts as -inf and is recorded
arms.B11_lsml: frozen bank11 L-SML (calfix_common.lsml_fit on bank11, anchor entropy)

selection_access.objective: PRMScore (official formula) on the fit folds' non-control PRMBench steps; decision threshold = q80 of the model's own calibration-fold scores (P1 rule, label-free)
selection_access.labels: fit folds' PRMBench labels only; calibration- and evaluation-fold labels are set to NaN in the array the selector receives and any read of them raises (tail_calib_common.fit_prmscore)
selection_access.processbench: not used for any choice; secondary panel only

evaluation: calfix_evaluate.evaluate unchanged: P1 (primary, pooled cal q80), P1b, P2 (label-using panel); within-answer AUC; PB SLA macro8; paired source-group bootstrap 20,000 draws seed 20260924; official PRMScore replay < 1e-12
primary_contrasts_P1_prmscore_holm7: defect fix: standardized marks vs the V1 recipe
corrected tail L-SML vs matched equal
learning object: standardized tail marks vs continuous covariance
calibrated tail L-SML vs matched equal
descriptive_contrasts: exact Lemma-1 K criterion vs unit
learned magnitudes vs equal on discovered groups
V1 recipe vs equal (replays the calfix contrast)
calibrated tail L-SML vs bank11 anchor
stage0_diagnosis_label_free: for F15, K28, A48o and bank11 (tie-aware 20% marks as in calfix) and every outer fold: K, partition, per-K residual curve and relative gap under raw marks, standardized marks and continuous features, each with unit/eigen/complete; pooled mark variances; scale control = continuous F15 covariance x0.16 (data x0.4) under the raw path; cross-fold ARI of the F15 partitions; consistency of raw-unit K with the V1 MODELS.jsonl K. Output DIAGNOSIS.json.
descriptive_label_using_after_fits: per family and q (rank and value): d_j(q) = mean mark | error - mean mark | valid on non-control PRMBench steps (all folds, descriptive only); 20% mark correlations within valid steps and within error steps (conditional-independence check) summarized inside vs across T20s groups; mark position (mean relative position, share in the last 20% of steps, answers with >= 5 steps). Never used for selection.
stop_rule: report a matched table and a recommendation; no TRANSFER_LOCK_V2 without Omri's decision (a new file; V1 unchanged; records the external-exposure timing above); no commit without request.
